definition: A human language used for speaking and writing.
example: An editor checks a Slovak school announcement.

definition: A human language also known as Slovenian.
example: A translator prepares a Slovene audio guide.

definition: An object-oriented programming language built around objects and message sending.
example: A developer sends a filtering message to a collection.

definition: A historical Iranian language attested in written documents and inscriptions.
example: A scholar transliterates a Sogdian manuscript fragment.

definition: A human language used in oral and written communication.
example: An interpreter explains service instructions in Somali.

definition: A human language used in speech and writing across multiple regional standards.
example: An editor localizes a Spanish product manual for its intended audience.

definition: A declarative language for querying and managing relational data.
example: An analyst selects sales totals grouped by month.

definition: An ancient human language attested in cuneiform texts.
example: A scholar translates a Sumerian administrative tablet.

definition: A human language used in speech and writing.
example: A translator checks a Sundanese community notice.

definition: A group of German dialects conventionally called Swabian.

definition: A human language used in oral and written communication, including as a lingua franca.

definition: A human language also known as siSwati.

definition: A human language used in speech and writing.

definition: A language that adds static types to JavaScript and compiles to JavaScript.
